about: Professor Hoot's lines for Balance Altar (docs/design/games/balance-altar.md section 3.8): each spoken by itself (PlayVoice.say), at most 12 words; [n gems] is said as a number ('one gem', 'four gems'); a question names what answers it: 'world' (what happens next) or the pictures a HUD shows. R1-R3 are examples of the rune line's reading (AltarRunes.say makes them from the pans); H7 is the gems counting themselves, one number word a gem.

lines.text: Welcome to the Sky Temple! Its crystals are frozen.
A Glimmer sleeps in each crystal. Let's wake them!
Watch: the same off both pans.
Your turn!
Fair and square! The altar stays level.
Free! It weighs [n gems]!

lines.when: the gems count themselves (one number word a gem)
lines.text: One, two, three!
It's flying up to the chandelier!
Whoa! The altar wants fair moves.

lines.when: see why, after a rule break
lines.text: The same on both pans!
Moving it across changes both pans. Same on both!
Watch: share both pans fairly. Keep one share.

lines.when: see why after the first share
lines.text: Two crystals weighed six. So one weighs three!
They won't share fairly.

lines.when: the ghost's step after two refusals
lines.text: Watch me do one.

lines.when: a lift with no possible twin, after 8 s
lines.text: The other pan has none. Put it back.
The Great Altar! Free its crystal to light the hall.
The hall is lit! Listen to them sing!
Whatever you do to one pan, do to the other.
Grown-ups call this an equation. You just solved eleven!
The great door is open. The Sky Room awaits!
Wonderful keeping! Another hall?

lines.when: an altar's start, the rune line read (pictures)
lines.text: A crystal and three gems weigh seven gems.

lines.when: the answer read at the free
lines.text: One crystal weighs four gems.
x plus three equals seven.
crystal
The Sky Room! Up here, balloons pull pans up.
Balloons pull pans up. Gems pull them down.

lines.when: waiting 15 s (once; the goal, not the move)
lines.text: Make the crystal alone. Fair moves only.
A gem and a balloon cancel out. Pop!
To undo a balloon, add a gem to both pans.
You found the Sky Room's secret, like a real Keeper!
Fair and square!
Same on both pans. Perfect!
You shared it out. Clever!
Straight to the answer!
You're a real Keeper now!
Hoo hoo! Well kept!
Need a rest? The triangle goes on, the door stops.
Leave the temple? Your Glimmers will wait.
Oops! A sleepy one!
Hoo! Look how bright!
It's like a crystal palace!
